player_prompt.intro:
I yɛ Jokɔli {player_id} ({role}) o cɛ {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies kɛlɛ.
- Anw taa, jɛn bɛ [heads] anw [tails] (anw [h], [t]).
- I ka jɛ kɛlɛcogo fɛ, Jokɔli 0 taa taa; nka, Jokɔli 1 taa.
Jɛn bɛ a jɛ kɛlɛ '[heads]' anw '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Jokɔli 0 da {choice0}; Jokɔli 1 da {choice1}. Match -> Jokɔli 0 taa.
message.round_mismatch: Jokɔli 0 da {choice0}; Jokɔli 1 da {choice1}. Mismatch -> Jokɔli 1 taa.

outcome.p0_wins: Ɲiningali 0 ye se sɔrɔ siɲɛ caaman.
outcome.p1_wins: Ɲiningali 1 ye see sɔrɔ siɲɛ caaman.
outcome.draw: A laban, u bɛɛ bɔnɛna wari la.
